t: What Sequential Consistency Internals Is All About
title: What Sequential Consistency Internals Is All About
description: Lamport's condition: all operations appear in some global order respecting program order.. This database covers Sequential Consistency Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Isolation levels define which anomalies are possible.
definition: Sequential Consistency Internals — Lamport's condition: all operations appear in some global order respecting program order.
key_points: Isolation levels define which anomalies are possible.
Read-uncommitted allows dirty reads; almost never use it.
Read-committed is the default; each statement sees committed data.
Repeatable-read gives transaction snapshots; phantoms vary by engine.
